samples.title: Phân loại rác
samples.prompt: Your friend is interested in sorting household waste but does not know where to begin. Write an email giving practical advice, explaining a possible difficulty, and offering help.
requirementsVi: Cho bước bắt đầu cụ thể.
Giải thích một khó khăn và cách xử lý.
Đề nghị hỗ trợ thực tế.
samples.summaryVi: Phân loại cần thùng và hướng dẫn rõ, đồng thời hệ thống thu gom phải thực hiện đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for telling me about your interest in sorting household waste. I understand why you are unsure where to start. You do not need a perfect plan immediately, but a few practical steps could make things easier.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đồng cảm, xác định mục đích khuyên.

paragraphs.label: Lời khuyên đầu
paragraphs.text: First, I suggest joining a neighbourhood recycling workshop at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. There, we can practise sorting common household items. One useful point is that more recyclable material can be collected separately. For example, a family can keep a small box for clean bottles instead of putting them in the same bag as dinner leftovers.
paragraphs.noteVi: Gợi ý hoạt động có ngày, nơi và lý do.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn và cách xử lý
paragraphs.text: One thing to remember is that residents may stop sorting if collection is unreliable. This can happen because the instructions and collection system may not match. A useful response would be to provide simple labels and explain how each type of waste is collected. For instance, a building manager could place picture labels above bins and publish a reliable collection schedule. Try the idea on a small scale before deciding whether to continue.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu giới hạn để lời khuyên không tuyệt đối.

paragraphs.label: Đề nghị và kết
paragraphs.text:
If you like, I can come with you and help you write down the most useful points. Afterwards, we could make a simple plan together.

Please let me know what you think when you have a moment. I would be happy to answer any other questions.

Best wishes,
Minh
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỗ trợ cụ thể, không chỉ nói good luck.
